inputs.original_text: Recalling the role that China and the United States played in consolidating unity and laying the foundation for the Paris Agreement, he expressed strong disappointment at seeing the US withdraw from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration.
inputs.modified_text: He’s right to be disappointed: the US withdrawing from the Paris Agreement for a second time under the Donald Trump administration weakens the cooperation needed to confront a crisis that hits vulnerable communities hardest. The contrast is stark—the US and China helped build the unity behind the agreement, yet political choices can undo that work and put short-term interests ahead of shared responsibility.🌱
